96-  # ── Path-scoped matcher (story scope-admin-claim-to-path) ──────────────────────
97-  #
98-  # SEC (closes Kassandra MEDIUM, bugfix-unify-admin-matrix-oidc-identity +
99-  # bugfix-nested-oidc-claim-support, both 2026-07-01): `claim_value_matches?/2`
100-  # above matches `target` against EVERY value in the claims tree, regardless of
101-  # which key/path it appears under. That means a non-admin whose IdP lets them
102-  # self-set an unrelated claim (e.g. `name`, `preferred_username`,
103-  # `address.locality`) to the configured admin-marker value would be
104-  # misclassified as admin. `claim_at_path_matches?/3` fixes this by resolving
105-  # ONLY the value(s) at `path` (a dot-path string, e.g. `"realm_access.roles"`
106-  # or a flat `"groups"`) and matching `target` against just that subtree — a
107-  # hit anywhere else in the claims map does not count.
108-
109-  @doc """
110-  True when `target` is present in `claims` at the exact `path` (dot-path
111-  string, e.g. `"realm_access.roles"` or a flat `"groups"`) — as an exact
112-  binary match, a list member, or nested inside a map/list at any depth
113-  *below* that path. A hit anywhere else in the claims tree does NOT count.
114-
115-  Returns `false` when `path` is `nil`/empty or resolves to nothing (fails
116-  closed — an unset/misconfigured path never grants admin).
117-  """
118-  @spec claim_at_path_matches?(map(), String.t() | nil, binary()) :: boolean()
119-  def claim_at_path_matches?(claims, path, target)
120-      when is_map(claims) and is_binary(path) and path != "" and is_binary(target) do
121-    case resolve_path(claims, String.split(path, ".")) do
122-      {:ok, value} -> claim_value_matches?(value, target)
123-      :error -> false
124-    end
125-  end

127-  def claim_at_path_matches?(_claims, _path, _target), do: false
